caption: Hassan v. City of New York
citation_line: Hassan v. City of New York, 804 F.3d 277 (3d Cir. 2015)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Martini dismissed constitutional claims brought by Muslim individuals and organizations challenging the New York Police Department’s post-September 11 surveillance program in New Jersey.
qualification_rationale: The case arose from nationally reported surveillance of Muslim communities and produced a major precedential equal-protection and standing opinion concerning government classification on the basis of religion.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit reversed, holding that the plaintiffs plausibly alleged injury, discriminatory purpose and intentional discrimination, and permitted the constitutional claims to proceed.
